```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (21.0, 12.0, 24.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak/moderate inversion, efficiency)
    "L1":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # input pair L (gain + flicker area)
    "itail": (12.5e-6, 6e-6, 16e-6), # first-stage tail current
    "gmid4": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L4":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror L (gain vs mirror pole)
    "gmid7": (13.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # output PMOS CS gm/Id
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.2),        # output PMOS L (fT vs gain)
    "i7":    (13.8e-6, 10e-6, 17e-6),# output stage current (slew into CL)
    "gmidb": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # NMOS bias mirror gm/Id (ref/tail/sink)
    "Lb":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # NMOS bias mirror L (CMRR, output gds)
    "cc":    (0.55e-12, 0.3e-12, 1.0e-12),  # Miller capacitor
    "kz":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # Rz / Rz_cancel  (1 -> zero cancels p2)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it = p["itail"]; i1 = it / 2.0; i7 = p["i7"]; Cc = p["cc"]

    # ---- bias mirror: ibias diode -> tail (M5) and output sink (M8), same gm/Id and L ----
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.6)
    vb = mb.vgs
    W5 = mb.W * it / iref
    W8 = mb.W * i7 / iref
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], it, vds=0.35)     # for gds prediction
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], i7, vds=0.9)

    # ---- first stage ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.35)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], i1, vds=0.95)      # diode + mirror (M3=M4)
    # ---- second stage ----
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], i7, vds=0.9)

    gm1, gm3, gm7 = m1.gm, m3.gm, m7.gm

    # nulling resistor: zero cancels output pole p2 ~ gm7*Cc/((CL+Cc)*...)
    Rz = p["kz"] * (CL + Cc) / (gm7 * Cc)

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", mb.W, p["Lb"])
    n.M("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W5, p["Lb"])
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)     # inverting side (diode side)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)     # non-inverting -> n1
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.M("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W8, p["Lb"])
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    gain_db = db(A0)

    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    w_u = gm1 / Cc
    ugbw = w_u / (2 * PI)
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (C1 * CL + Cc * (C1 + CL))
    p3 = 1.0 / (Rz * C1)
    d = Rz - 1.0 / gm7
    zph = math.degrees(math.atan(w_u * Cc * abs(d)))
    zph = zph if d > 0 else -zph
    pmir = gm3 / (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd)
    pm = (90 - math.degrees(math.atan(w_u / p2)) + zph
          - math.degrees(math.atan(w_u / p3))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(w_u / pmir))
          + math.degrees(math.atan(w_u / (2 * pmir))))

    slew = min(it / Cc, i7 / (CL + Cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i7)

    # CMRR: Acm1 ~ gds5/(2*gm3)
    cmrr_db = db(A1 * 2 * gm3 / max(m5.gds, 1e-12))
    psrr_db = gain_db - 2.0

    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat

    # noise: thermal + rough flicker (K_n ~1e-9, K_p ~2.5e-10 V^2*um^2*Hz)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = 2 * (8 * kT / 3) / gm1 * (1 + gm3 / gm1)
    f = 1e3
    fl_n = 2 * 1e-9 / (m1.W * m1.L * f)
    fl_p = 2 * 2.5e-10 / (m3.W * m3.L * f) * (gm3 / gm1) ** 2
    noise_1k = math.sqrt(th + fl_n + fl_p)

    settle = 0.5 / slew + 5.0 / (w_u * 0.8)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db,
               "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise_1k, "settle": settle}
```
